headline: Canon's EOS R8 II is its lightest full-frame camera with 5-axis stabilization, shooting 40 fps
summary: Canon's new 24MP EOS R8 II brings 5-axis in-body stabilization and 40 fps shooting to its entry-level full-frame lineup, sporting a retro design inspired by the classic EOS 650 SLR. It's available for pre-order at $1,899.
details: Canon has unveiled the 24-megapixel EOS R8 II, an entry-level full-frame camera now featuring 5-axis in-body stabilization and capable of shooting at 40 fps. It is also the lightest full-frame camera on the market with this feature, weighing just 1.2 pounds (546 grams). The camera is available for pre-order at $1,899.

The R8 II sports an all-new styling, borrowing design cues from its classic EOS 650 SLR film camera, giving it a retro chic look. It features a more squared-off design and includes a joystick for moving the autofocus point, a feature missing from the previous R8 model.

Performance is significantly faster, with 40 fps electronic shutter shooting with continuous autofocus and auto-exposure. It also captures 58 percent more JPEG and 30 percent more RAW images in a burst compared to its predecessor. The 5-axis in-body stabilization reduces shake by up to 7.5 stops with supported lenses.

The autofocus system has been overhauled with Canon's Dual Pixel CMOS AF II, offering 100 percent coverage and tenacious subject tracking for people, animals, and vehicles. It also includes pre-continuous shooting, capturing up to 20 frames before the shutter is fully pressed, and the ability to register specific people for tracking.

Video capabilities remain strong, supporting 4K 60p oversampled from the full 6K sensor width and uncropped 1080p at 180 fps. It offers 10-bit 4:2:2 capture with Canon Log3 in HEVC or AVC codecs, with improved video autofocus matching photo tracking features.

Additional features include new Positive Filmtone, Negative Filmtone, and Night Scene film looks, plus an A+ Automatic Exposure with a blurred background setting for movies. It also has a separate Slow & Fast mode, a single UHS II card slot, and enhanced stabilization for video.
The Canon EOS R8 II is on pre-order for $1,899 body-only, with shipping expected in late October. A kit with the RF24-50mm F/4.5-6.3 IS STM lens is available for $2,099.

headline_marked: [[OmniFocus & Ulysses gain Siri AI support]] for iOS 27, macOS 27 updates
headline: OmniFocus & Ulysses gain Siri AI support for iOS 27, macOS 27 updates
summary: Omni Group's productivity apps, OmniFocus and Ulysses, are updated with Siri AI capabilities and new features for Apple's upcoming iOS 27 and macOS 27. watchOS 27 also enhances Siri with chat continuity.
details: The Omni Group has updated its popular productivity apps, OmniFocus and Ulysses, to be ready for Apple's 2027 system updates from day one. These updates bring significant enhancements across iOS 27, macOS 27, and other platforms.

OmniFocus now integrates Siri AI, allowing users to leverage intelligent assistance for task management. This includes creating new lists and tasks directly through Siri, streamlining workflow and organization.

Ulysses also receives Siri AI support, alongside new features like customizable toolbars and project templates. These additions aim to provide a more tailored and efficient writing experience for users.

Beyond third-party apps, watchOS 27 introduces a new Siri app that allows users to continue existing conversations. While initially a bit hidden, this feature enhances the continuity of Siri interactions across Apple devices.
